proposals.label: UN role and modernization in AI
proposals.definition: The UN is positioned as the forum for AI, is asked to prioritize AI, or is urged to modernize itself and use AI (e.g., in peacekeeping, digital diplomacy).
proposals.inclusion: Passages urging the UN to be future-ready with AI, adopt AI in its work, or make AI a session priority.
proposals.exclusion: General international governance calls not tied to the UN (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
proposals.boundary_cases: AI aiding UN peacekeeping and conflict prevention counts here; AI in national militaries does not.

examples.quote: The United Nations must embrace digital diplomacy for the artificial intelligence age.
AI's transformative force can aid conflict prevention, peacekeeping and humanitarian options
support the proposal to make artificial intelligence a priority of the 80th session

proposals.label: AI listed among modern technologies
proposals.definition: AI named alongside other technologies or trends as a marker of modernity or threat, without further discussion.
proposals.inclusion: Passages where AI appears in a list (e.g., cryptocurrency, social media, internet) with no elaboration.
proposals.exclusion: Passages that go on to discuss AI specifically.
proposals.boundary_cases: A list that attributes a shared threat to all items remains a list mention unless AI is singled out.

examples.quote: We live in a world of cryptocurrency, artificial intelligence, social media, the internet and its dark hidden dungeon of the dark web

proposals.label: Africa's inclusion in AI
proposals.definition: Concern that the digital divide must close so that Africa and developing regions are included in AI.
proposals.inclusion: Passages calling for closing the digital divide or including Africa/Global South in AI.
proposals.exclusion: Generic development benefits of AI without inclusion concerns.
proposals.boundary_cases: Brief quoting of the Secretary-General on AI for Africa counts here.

examples.quote: the digital divide must close. As our friend, the Secretary General, has said, AI must turn for Africa, included.

proposals.label: Governance keeping pace with AI
proposals.definition: Governance of new spheres such as AI must keep up with their speed and scale, with new rules prioritising human dignity, alongside implementing the Global Digital Compact.
proposals.inclusion: Passages urging AI governance to keep pace with technology or new rules for AI.
proposals.exclusion: Misuse for terrorism or hate speech (use AI_CYBER_SECURITY/AI_DISINFORMATION).
proposals.boundary_cases: References to implementing the Global Digital Compact also take AI_UN_ROLE; dignity-first rules may also take AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: The governance of new spheres of human activity, including artificial intelligence, the Internet and outer space, must keep up with the speed and scale
New rules should place human dignity as the priority.

proposals.label: AI misuse for terrorism and incitement
proposals.definition: AI and social media increasingly used for incitement, terrorist recruitment and hate speech, affecting cybersecurity and requiring international cooperation.
proposals.inclusion: Passages on AI used for terrorist recruitment, incitement or hate speech, with cybersecurity effects.
proposals.exclusion: Pure mis/disinformation without violent-extremism content (use AI_DISINFORMATION).
proposals.boundary_cases: Lists combining terrorism and disinformation take both codes.

examples.quote: increasingly being used for incitement, terrorist recruitment and spreading hate speech, misinformation and disinformation, with adverse effects on cybersecurity

proposals.label: AI spreading misinformation harming youth
proposals.definition: AI spreading misinformation and disinformation, with young people as victims.
proposals.inclusion: Passages linking AI to mis/disinformation.
proposals.exclusion: Terrorism-only misuse.
proposals.boundary_cases: Youth victimisation may also take AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION if education remedies are discussed.

examples.quote: Many young people have fallen victim to those negative practices.

proposals.label: Pact for the Future and AI at UN
proposals.definition: The UN, via the Pact for the Future, as the venue for addressing AI, whether praised as opening the AI conversation or criticized for its process.
proposals.inclusion: Passages linking AI to the Pact for the Future or asserting that AI rules must be agreed universally within the UN.
proposals.exclusion: General UN reform passages without AI content.
proposals.boundary_cases: Criticism of the Pact's drafting counts here when tied to AI legal frameworks.

examples.quote: We also opened a conversation about the critically important issue of how to make artificial intelligence a force for good.
Those issues touch upon the future of all humankind and must be considered on a universal basis, without discrimination or aspirations to achieve unilateral benefits.

proposals.label: Objection to Western narrow AI formats
proposals.definition: Objection that Western states create narrow formats outside the UN to set AI legal frameworks, undermining universal and equal participation.
proposals.inclusion: Passages accusing specific states or blocs of setting AI rules in exclusive or subordinate formats bypassing the UN.
proposals.exclusion: General calls for inclusive governance without accusations of exclusive rule-making.
proposals.boundary_cases: Also relevant to sovereignty/concentration; code here when the complaint is about governance venues.

examples.quote: in circumvention of the United Nations — to create subordinate, narrow formats to resolve crucial issues, such as control over the Internet or determination of legal frameworks to use artificial intelligence technologies

proposals.label: AI named among new global challenges
proposals.definition: AI cited alongside climate change as an example of new international issues, without substantive elaboration.
proposals.inclusion: Passages where AI appears as one of several new challenges facing multilateralism.
proposals.exclusion: Passages that discuss AI benefits, risks or standards specifically.
proposals.boundary_cases: A short clause that AI is evolving at a furious pace remains a list mention if nothing further follows.

examples.quote: emerging technology, including artificial intelligence, which is evolving at a furious pace
Whether it is climate change or artificial intelligence

proposals.label: World not dictated by tech companies
proposals.definition: Assertion that global order must not be subcontracted to the richest companies or dictated by the pace of technology.
proposals.inclusion: Passages rejecting control of global affairs by tech companies or technology pace.
proposals.exclusion: Specific AI regulation proposals (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE or AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
proposals.boundary_cases: Implicit references to tech companies without naming AI count only in AI-focused context.

examples.quote: Nor can it be subcontracted to the world's richest companies or dictated by the pace of technology.

proposals.label: National AI standards after security incident
proposals.definition: Speaker describes national AI standards and regulation, prompted by incidents such as an AI agent infiltrating a government website.
proposals.inclusion: Passages on domestic AI standards, digital duty of care or national regulatory leadership on AI.
proposals.exclusion: International calls for action (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
proposals.boundary_cases: Joining other nations in a call for action takes AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE as well.

examples.quote: Australia has been leading the way in establishing Australian standards for AI
Recently, an artificial intelligence agent infiltrated an Australian government website.

proposals.label: AI benefits versus frontier risks
proposals.definition: AI framed as improving lives and productivity while carrying frontier risks if developed too fast without guardrails.
proposals.inclusion: Passages pairing AI benefits (health, growth) with warnings about frontier AI risks.
proposals.exclusion: One-sided statements.
proposals.boundary_cases: Citing AI company leaders' warnings alongside benefits counts here and may take AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL.

examples.quote: leaders of AI companies themselves have warned of the potential risks to allow frontier AI to develop too fast without guardrails

proposals.label: Joint call to shape AI development
proposals.definition: Joining with other nations to call for action to shape AI development proactively.
proposals.inclusion: Passages on multilateral calls to shape or govern AI development.
proposals.exclusion: Purely domestic standards.
proposals.boundary_cases: If the call is specifically about frontier-model control mechanisms, also code AI_HUMAN_CONTROL_OVERSIGHT.

examples.quote: we joined with other nations this week to call for action to shape artificial intelligence development rather than be passively shaped by it

proposals.label: Need for AI rules and regulation
proposals.definition: Calls for regulation of AI and lament that AI is developing without agreed rules and boundaries.
proposals.inclusion: Passages supporting AI regulation or criticizing the absence of international rules for AI.
proposals.exclusion: Passages about the UN's institutional weakness that do not mention AI regulation.
proposals.boundary_cases: Complaints that the UN is sidelined on AI regulation should also be coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence is developing with lightning speed, largely unchecked, with obvious risks to our social fabric, but without any agreement on rules and boundaries.
Liechtenstein supports the regulation of artificial intelligence.

proposals.label: UN sidelined on AI regulation
proposals.definition: The UN as the proper forum for AI regulation, and concern that it is ignored or sidelined on this issue.
proposals.inclusion: Passages linking AI regulation to the UN's role, relevance or marginalization.
proposals.exclusion: General UN reform discussion with no AI link.
proposals.boundary_cases: If AI is only one example of UN marginalization, still code here.

examples.quote: It is increasingly ignored or sidelined in efforts to address both the traditional and new challenges, such as the regulation of artificial intelligence.

proposals.label: Utopia or apocalypse and species-level risk
proposals.definition: Concern about catastrophic or species-level consequences of AI and a race that deprioritizes safety.
proposals.inclusion: Passages warning about AI apocalypse, the future of the human species, or an AI race neglecting safety.
proposals.exclusion: Military targeting uses of AI (code AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS).
proposals.boundary_cases: Utopia/apocalypse framing may also be coded duality, but here the emphasis is on risk and the race.

examples.quote: we are on a precipice either of a technology-fueled utopia or an apocalypse
how can we risk the consequences to human rights, to our environment, to the long term capacities for our critical thinking and ultimately to the future of the human species?

proposals.label: AI in military targeting
proposals.definition: Harms to civilians from integration of AI into military targeting and warfare.
proposals.inclusion: Passages referencing AI in targeting systems, warfare or armed forces.
proposals.exclusion: Non-military AI risks.
proposals.boundary_cases: The phrase 'victims in its crosshairs' counts when tied to military targeting.

examples.quote: We are already seeing the impacts on civilians as armed forces increasingly integrate AI capabilities into their targeting systems in warfare.

proposals.label: AI made for humanity
proposals.definition: AI must serve humanity and protect human rights, social fabric and critical thinking.
proposals.inclusion: Passages insisting AI be human-centred or warning of risks to rights and the social fabric.
proposals.exclusion: Purely technical safety or military passages.
proposals.boundary_cases: Mentions of risks to 'social fabric' without detail lean here.

examples.quote: AI tools have to be made for humanity, lest we become the source material for AI systems to use

proposals.label: Few companies and countries deciding AI
proposals.definition: Concern that a small group of companies and countries could take all decisions about AI while others look on.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages objecting to concentration of AI decision-making among a few firms or states.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude access-gap framings without a power/decision element (AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE).
proposals.boundary_cases: When the proposed remedy is deciding within the UN, also code AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: Do we let a small group of companies and countries take all the decisions while the rest of us simply look on?

proposals.label: UN as forum for collective AI decisions
proposals.definition: The United Nations is presented as the setting in which states should jointly decide the future of AI.
proposals.inclusion: Include statements that AI decisions should be made within the UN or UN processes.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude using AI to reform UN operations (AI_UN_EFFICIENCY).
proposals.boundary_cases: General multilateral governance calls without naming the UN go to AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: do we decide together, within the logical setting of the United Nations, what our future should look like?

proposals.label: Using AI to improve multilateral institutions
proposals.definition: AI presented as a tool to boost the efficiency and effectiveness of the UN and multilateral institutions as part of reform efforts like UN80.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages proposing the use of AI within the UN system or multilateral institutions to improve operations.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude governance of AI by the UN (AI_UN_ROLE).
proposals.boundary_cases: Generic 'use technology in UN reform' without AI is not coded.

examples.quote: we must work together by using AI and other technologies wherever possible
explore new ways of boosting the efficiency and effectiveness of multilateral institutions

proposals.label: Unregulated AI among global threats
proposals.definition: Unregulated AI named briefly alongside climate, pandemics and other crises as threats that a rules-based system must help face.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages listing 'unregulated AI' among global challenges without further elaboration.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages that detail specific AI harms or governance proposals.
proposals.boundary_cases: A list item that adds a promise/risk qualifier is also coded AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY.

examples.quote: to allow us to better face challenges from climate to pandemics to unregulated AI

proposals.label: Tremendous promise, significant unregulated risk
proposals.definition: Brief framing of unregulated AI as holding tremendous promise but posing significant risk.
proposals.inclusion: Include explicit promise-and-risk statements about AI, even when brief.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude bare list mentions with no promise/risk framing.
proposals.boundary_cases: Where the risk is tied to lack of regulation, also consider AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE if rules are demanded for AI specifically.

examples.quote: unregulated AI, which while it has tremendous promise, poses unregulated significant risk

proposals.label: AI as force for peace, not domination
proposals.definition: AI and related digital/space technologies should serve peace and development rather than be tools of domination by powers.
proposals.inclusion: Passages framing AI normatively as a force for peace versus an instrument of domination.
proposals.exclusion: Specific military or autonomous weapons discussion (use AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS).
proposals.boundary_cases: If domination is framed as concentration of AI power in a few states, also code AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: the artificial intelligence technologies as force for peace, not tools for domination

proposals.label: Bridging digital and technological divides
proposals.definition: Bridging digital and technological divides as central to resilient societies and development.
proposals.inclusion: Passages calling to bridge digital/technological divides in connection with AI.
proposals.exclusion: Passages about divides unrelated to technology.
proposals.boundary_cases: Generic digital-divide calls count only when AI is referenced nearby.

examples.quote: Bridging the digital and technological divides is central to build resilient societies.

proposals.label: National AI investment as modernization showcase
proposals.definition: The speaker's country showcases its investments in AI alongside space, energy and other advanced fields as evidence of national development and regional leadership.
proposals.inclusion: Passages naming national investment in AI, or national ambitions to become an AI or technology hub.
proposals.exclusion: Passages about AI's global governance or risks.
proposals.boundary_cases: When AI is only one entry in a list of national investment fields, also code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: The UAE continues to expand its investments in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, healthcare, and education.
My country focuses on anticipating challenges and on investing in advanced fields, such as artificial intelligence, space technology and renewable energy.

proposals.label: AI listed among advanced fields
proposals.definition: AI is named in a list of technologies or sectors without further elaboration.
proposals.inclusion: Passages where AI appears alongside space, renewable energy, science or healthcare as list items.
proposals.exclusion: Passages that describe what AI does or should do.
proposals.boundary_cases: A regional vision of AI 'thriving' in a list remains a list mention.

examples.quote: where new technology, science, renewable energy and artificial intelligence will thrive

proposals.label: AI for sustainable development and services
proposals.definition: AI presented as a tool for sustainable development, innovative solutions and government services, deserving international investment.
proposals.inclusion: Passages urging use of or investment in AI to accelerate sustainable development or improve business, lives and government services.
proposals.exclusion: Mere naming of AI as an investment sector without development purpose.
proposals.boundary_cases: Support to other countries' AI capacity should additionally be coded capacity building.

examples.quote: international attention and investments should be directed towards those technologies in order to accelerate sustainable development
my country has sought to harness these tools to advance sustainable development around the world

proposals.label: Supporting other countries' AI capacities
proposals.definition: Support for other (often Global South) countries in building technological and AI capacity, with responsible and ethical use.
proposals.inclusion: Passages offering support to build other states' technological/AI capacity.
proposals.exclusion: Domestic-only AI investment.
proposals.boundary_cases: Ethics qualifiers attached to capacity support stay here unless ethics is the main point.

examples.quote: We support countries to build their technological capacities while respecting their national values and priorities

proposals.label: Call for binding international AI treaty
proposals.definition: Speaker calls for an international treaty, convention or binding framework to govern AI development, often likening it to nuclear safeguards.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages explicitly calling for a treaty, convention, binding framework or international laws regulating AI.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude general praise of cooperation on AI without any call for rules or regulation.
proposals.boundary_cases: Calls for international laws specifically on military AI are coded AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS and may also be coded here if general regulation is urged.

examples.quote: today we call for an international treaty governing the development of artificial intelligence
we renew our call for a binding international framework to ensure that this technology becomes a driver of innovation rather than division

proposals.label: Warning on military AI and autonomous weapons
proposals.definition: Speaker warns about military applications of AI and autonomous weapons and seeks legal regulation of them.
proposals.inclusion: Include explicit references to military uses of AI, autonomous weapons, or AI exacerbating armed conflict.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude general references to peace or security without a military-use dimension.
proposals.boundary_cases: Statements that AI should contribute to peace rather than conflict, without naming weapons, are primarily AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: The Kingdom also warns of the dangers of the military uses of artificial intelligence applications and autonomous weapons.

proposals.label: AI within national development and diversification
proposals.definition: AI is named as part of the country's own economic vision, digital transformation, or modernization agenda, usually briefly and among other sectors.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages where AI is listed as a national priority or sector the government supports or promotes.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages where AI is discussed mainly as a global governance problem.
proposals.boundary_cases: Very brief listings of AI among many domestic priorities may also warrant AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: with support for the digital economy and artificial-intelligence technologies, tourism, logistics and financial sectors
We also place high importance on digital transformation, artificial intelligence applications, innovation, industrial development
We also seek to promote digital innovation and artificial intelligence with the aim of providing a safe, stable, prosperous, and sustainable environment.

proposals.label: International AI capacity-building and ethics centres
proposals.definition: Speaker highlights hosting or leading international networks and centres for AI capacity building, research and ethics, linked to UN/UNESCO processes.
proposals.inclusion: Include references to AI capacity-building centres, research networks, or institutions supporting other countries' AI capacity.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude domestic-only AI investments with no international capacity-building role.
proposals.boundary_cases: Mentions of the Pact for the Future or UNESCO as auspices may also be coded AI_UN_ROLE; ethics centres may also be AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: The Kingdom has taken a leading role in establishing the International Network of Artificial Intelligence Capacity Building Centres

proposals.label: New power divide over compute and data
proposals.definition: Concern that AI creates a new power divide based on compute, data, models, skills and finance, and insistence that technology be a global public good rather than a privilege of few states or corporations.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages warning of AI concentrating power in a limited number of states/corporations or calling technology a global public benefit.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages only requesting access for developing countries without a power-concentration argument.
proposals.boundary_cases: Demands that developing countries become producers not just consumers fit here and in AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: it may also create a vast new divide in power linked to computing capacity, data, models, skills, and financing
technology is a global public benefit and not an exclusive privilege enjoyed by a limited number of states or corporations

proposals.label: Developing-country access to AI
proposals.definition: Calls to enhance developing countries' access to AI and digital technologies, often in a development-finance context.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages requesting access to AI for developing countries.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude detailed governance principle lists without access claims.
proposals.boundary_cases: Brief access requests within a finance-for-development paragraph count here even if AI is not elaborated.

examples.quote: We also look forward to enhancing efforts for developing countries to have access to AI and digital technologies.

proposals.label: UN role on AI and emerging challenges
proposals.definition: Acknowledgement or support of the UN's role and a global dialogue in addressing AI, sometimes contrasted with the UN's failures on collective security.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages endorsing UN or global dialogue roles on AI, or referencing the UN's work on AI as an emerging challenge.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude UN reform passages without AI.
proposals.boundary_cases: A backhanded mention (UN AI work should not distract from peace and security failures) still counts here.

examples.quote: the welcome role that the United Nations is trying to play in confronting emerging challenges, such as digital cooperation, crime, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence
It supports the role of the United Nations and a global dialogue to develop principles that balance innovation and responsibility

proposals.label: Principles: privacy, oversight, non-discrimination, diversity
proposals.definition: AI governance principles such as privacy, transparency, accountability, non-discrimination, human oversight, and linguistic/cultural representation in data and models.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages listing ethical governance principles for AI or calling for fair representation of languages and cultures in AI.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude pure access or finance claims.
proposals.boundary_cases: Cultural/linguistic representation in AI models counts here as a fairness concern.

examples.quote: protect privacy, guarantee transparency, accountability, non-discrimination, human oversight
Arab and African languages and communities should receive fair representation in data and models.

proposals.label: Egypt's national AI strategy
proposals.definition: Reference to the speaker's national AI strategy and national capacity development.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages announcing or describing a national AI strategy.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude international governance proposals.
proposals.boundary_cases: Statements linking safe use and national capacity count here.

examples.quote: Egypt has launched the second edition of its national artificial intelligence strategy 2025-2030.

proposals.label: AI listed among revolutions Africa joins
proposals.definition: AI named in a list of current technological and energy revolutions that a region aspires to join, with no further discussion.
proposals.inclusion: Include single-sentence mentions listing AI alongside digitalization, renewables or other trends.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate AI's risks, benefits or governance.
proposals.boundary_cases: If the aspiration to 'join' is linked to explicit capacity or divide arguments, code AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE instead.

examples.quote: joining the revolutions currently taking place in the fields of artificial intelligence, digitalization and renewable energy

proposals.label: Africa not a marginal AI consumer
proposals.definition: Refusal that Africa remain marginal or a mere consumer of AI, and concern AI becomes a new North-South development gap.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages warning of AI creating North-South gaps or relegating regions to consumers.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude generic development statements without AI/technology.
proposals.boundary_cases: Investment in scientific and digital capacities in the same passage also counts under AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: not a new label for another development gap between the North and the South
we cannot accept that Africa would remain on the margins or simply become a consumer of its outputs

proposals.label: Investing in African scientific and digital capacities
proposals.definition: Building human, scientific and digital capacities so AI becomes a tool for development.
proposals.inclusion: Include calls to invest in people and skills/capacities for AI in developing regions.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude requests for regulation.
proposals.boundary_cases: Where framed as 'tool for development', also code AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: invest in the African person to build scientific and digital capacities so that artificial intelligence becomes a tool for development

proposals.label: Balanced international AI regulation
proposals.definition: Call for balanced and responsible international regulation of AI guaranteeing equitable access.
proposals.inclusion: Include calls for international regulation of AI.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude national regulation.
proposals.boundary_cases: Regulation justified by preventing monopoly is also coded AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: We call for a balanced and responsible international regulation of artificial intelligence

proposals.label: Against AI monopoly by a few
proposals.definition: Concern that AI becomes an exclusive privilege or monopoly of a few and that state sovereignty must be preserved.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages opposing AI monopoly/concentration or invoking state sovereignty in AI.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude access-gap statements without concentration/sovereignty language.
proposals.boundary_cases: 'Shared opportunity' language alone without monopoly framing belongs to AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: rather than an exclusive privilege or monopoly in the hands of a few

proposals.label: AI accelerating development goals
proposals.definition: AI's rapid development framed as offering great opportunities to accelerate development goals, conditional on proper governance.
proposals.inclusion: Passages stating AI can accelerate SDGs or development.
proposals.exclusion: Capacity/transfer demands (use AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING).
proposals.boundary_cases: Conditional opportunity statements tied to governance also take AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: the rapid development of artificial intelligence offers great opportunities to accelerate development goals

proposals.label: Equitable global AI governance
proposals.definition: Calls for comprehensive and equitable global governance ensuring responsible AI use.
proposals.inclusion: Passages calling for comprehensive, equitable or inclusive global AI governance.
proposals.exclusion: National AI policies.
proposals.boundary_cases: Governance framed around North-South equity also takes AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: accompanied by comprehensive and equitable global governance that ensure that responsible use

proposals.label: Preventing North-South AI divide
proposals.definition: Concern that AI widens the digital divide between North and South.
proposals.inclusion: Passages on preventing a North-South digital or AI divide.
proposals.exclusion: Specific support measures alone (use AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING).
proposals.boundary_cases: When remedies are listed, also code AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: prevents the widening of the digital divide between North and South

proposals.label: Capacity building, transfer and financing
proposals.definition: Remedies for AI inequality through capacity building, technology transfer, adequate financing, and fairer access to finance for digital transformation.
proposals.inclusion: Passages naming capacity building, technology transfer or financing for AI/digital development.
proposals.exclusion: Abstract inequality statements (use AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE).
proposals.boundary_cases: Financial architecture reform enabling technology investment counts when linked to AI.

examples.quote: through capacity building, technology transfer, and adequate financing

proposals.label: AI as terrifying new threat in passing
proposals.definition: AI is briefly named as a new and terrifying threat within a broader narrative about rising violence and conflict, without specifying the nature of the threat.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages that label AI as a threat in a single sentence among other global dangers, with no elaboration.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages that specify military, safety, or disinformation mechanisms (code the specific theme).
proposals.boundary_cases: An unspecified 'terrifying threat' framing is not AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL unless loss of control or catastrophe is described.

examples.quote: We see that new technologies, such as artificial intelligence, pose new and terrifying threats to all of us.

proposals.label: National AI scientific leadership
proposals.definition: Speaker cites own country's scientists as leaders in AI as a national strength.
proposals.inclusion: Passages boasting national AI research or talent leadership.
proposals.exclusion: International governance or rights positions.
proposals.boundary_cases: If AI appears only in a list of national strengths without claims of leadership, use AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: Our scientists are leaders in artificial intelligence and clean technology.

proposals.label: AI as a citizen worry
proposals.definition: AI mentioned as something ordinary citizens are worried about, alongside cost of living, foreign interference and disinformation, without elaboration.
proposals.inclusion: Passages reporting public anxiety or concern about AI.
proposals.exclusion: Passages that specify what the AI risk is (use the specific risk code).
proposals.boundary_cases: When disinformation is listed next to AI but not linked causally, keep this code rather than AI_DISINFORMATION.

examples.quote: They are also concerned about artificial intelligence, foreign interference, misinformation and disinformation.

proposals.label: Championing responsible AI development
proposals.definition: Brief commitment to be a trusted voice defending responsible AI development internationally, without specifying mechanisms.
proposals.inclusion: Passages pledging to promote responsible development of AI as a foreign policy priority.
proposals.exclusion: Concrete rules or institutional proposals (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
proposals.boundary_cases: If a specific international framework is named, use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE instead.

examples.quote: Canada will remain a voice that can be trusted, to defend maritime security, international law, and the responsible development of artificial intelligence

proposals.label: AI listed among domestic reform tools
proposals.definition: AI is named briefly in a list of technologies or reform measures within a national economic narrative, with no further discussion of AI.
proposals.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as one item among digitization, crypto, IT or other reform tools.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate on AI policy, risks, or governance.
proposals.boundary_cases: If the list item specifies a concrete national AI programme, code AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY instead.

examples.quote: embraced digitization, AI, and crypto as the tools of the future

proposals.label: Equipping youth with AI skills
proposals.definition: National efforts to equip young people with AI and IT skills as part of economic revival.
proposals.inclusion: Include mentions of training youth or students in AI skills.
proposals.exclusion: Exclude youth passages without AI.
proposals.boundary_cases: A brief list item on youth AI skills is coded here as well as AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION when no further detail is given.

examples.quote: equipping our youth with modern AI and IT skills
